{{Top|leg}}

A '''Holo House''' was an attraction similar to a house of mirrors, however, instead of mirrors there was illuminated laser lines that crisscrossed the multiple levels of the building. At the intersection of any two one would see a holoimage of someone of one or more people from anywhere in the building. The images looked indistinguishable from reality and were intangible. Holo Houses also had [[plastiform]] walls.<ref name="CNII:SOS">''[[Coruscant Nights II: Street of Shadows]]''</ref>

[[File:Streets_of_Shadows.jpg|thumb|left|250px|[[Laranth Tarak]] in a Holo House shooting at [[Aurra Sing/Legends|Aurra Sing]].]]
A Holo House was located at a fun fair on the lower levels of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. [[Aurra Sing/Legends|Aurra Sing]] hunted who she assumed was [[Jax Pavan]] and soon discovered him in the Holo House. As it turned out it was actually one of Jax's friends, [[Laranth Tarak]], a [[Gray Paladin]]. The two fought, jumping from one level to another with Aurra at one point slashing a plastiform wall with her [[Color/Legends|emerald]] [[Aurra Sing's green lightsaber|lightsaber]], scaring away the people on the other side with her reflections. Eventually, after Sing fired a shot at Laranth, the Paladin disappeared and Aurra resorted to sensing her presence before deciding to stalk Tarak until she lead him to Pavan.<ref name="CNII:SOS" />
